Name: Skippy's Bee Cats
Author: yeahSkippy
Description:
Created for Alternative Textures.

Have you ever wanted to dress up your cat as a bee? Well today is the day that you can do that. 

This is my first and probably only mod. I hope you enjoy it as much as I have. 

[b][font=Tahoma]Future Plans[/font][/b]
[list]
[*]Potentially adding more colors (like a rainbow!) if enough interest is presented to me.
[/list]
[b][font=Tahoma]Compatibility[/font][/b]
[list]
[*]Not compatible with other cat reskins or replacement mods using Content Patcher.
[*]It should work with other Alternative Texture mods you have.
[*]Has not been tested for mobile, but I'd consider it worth a try!
[/list]
